pending-clause.answer: The rule rests on §2002:14.5.12.2 (identifier-1 is a numeric sending operand: 'When the content of a boolean or numeric sending operand is referenced' ... false in the class test sets EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE; 2023 only splits out floating-point items, which an integer identifier-1 is not) and on §2002:14.5.12.1.2 (EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE is Fatal in the 2002 table). 2023's fatal and nonfatal processing differs from §2002:14.5.12.1.2/1.3 only by additions with no 2002 counterpart (the PERFORM WHEN path, §2023:14.6.13.1.3; SORT/MERGE and fatal EC-I-O steps; APPLY COMMIT rollback); the 2002 sequence (conditional phrase, declarative, PROPAGATE, abnormal termination, implementor-defined when unchecked) is 2023's without them, and §2002:14.5.12.2 differs only by 2023's floating-point arms. The checked path is shown at --std 2002 by pb395_goto_depending_incompatible (MATCH), the unchecked one by goto-dep.cob.
